curriculum.name: Accelerated Christian Education (A.C.E.)
curriculum.description: Biblically-integrated, self-paced mastery learning utilizing Packet of Accelerated Christian Education (PACE) workbooks.

term_package.title: A.C.E. Elementary Term 1 Complete PACE Pack
term_package.subtitle: Individualized PACE Mastery: Math, English, Science, Social Studies, Word Building, Bible Reading
features: Self-Instructional Daily Goal Setting & Goal Cards
Score Key Checkpoint Procedures & Self-Scoring System
Character Trait Focus: Attentiveness, Diligence & Resourcefulness
Comprehensive Checkups, Self-Tests & Final PACE Tests

learning_outcomes: Set daily page goals on Goal Card
Score PACE pages at scoring station with red pen

lessons.subject: Math PACE 1037
lessons.parent_script: Set your daily goal on your goal card: Complete pages 1-4 with diligence and accuracy.
lessons.learning_objective: Solve 20 single and double-digit multiplication problems and score at scoring station.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Complete pages 1 to 4 independently.
2. Proceed to scoring station, score with red pen.
3. Correct any mistakes and rescore.

lessons.subject: Science PACE 1037
lessons.parent_script: Science reveals the order of creation. Read page 3 aloud and observe the planetary orbits.
lessons.learning_objective: Identify the 8 planets in order from the Sun and explain gravity.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Read lesson narrative on page 2.
2. Fill in planetary characteristics table.
3. Memorize character scripture verse on Diligence.

lessons.subject: English & Word Building 1037
lessons.parent_script: Words are building blocks of thought. Identify the proper nouns in Ace and Christy dialogue.
lessons.learning_objective: Distinguish common nouns from proper nouns and apply correct capitalization rules.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Complete Word Building phonetic list #1.
2. Circle proper nouns in the paragraph.
3. Complete daily vocabulary review.
